_readme: query    — a natural-language search a real user would type.
expected — cafe names that SHOULD appear in the top results.
Case-insensitive substring match against the cafe `name`
notes    — optional, why these cafes are the right answer.
Entries with an empty `expected` run in TRIAGE mode: the script prints
their top-5 results so you can inspect them and fill in `expected`.
Seed queries below came from docs/PRD.md use cases; grow this list from
real searches in the nl_query_log table (aim for 30-50 labeled queries).
